card.title: IPhone XS with no touch

claims.statement: iPhone XS no touch is most commonly a top/bottom board disconnection; an OL at the touch FPC may instead be a nearby filter, so trace first.
Touch supplies: PP5V25_TOUCH_VDDH_CONN, PP3V5_RACER_CONN, PP1V1_RACER_CONN, PP1V8_TOUCH_RACER_CONN, PP10V0_RACER_CONN; missing ones mean U5600 (LM3373A2YKA).

procedure: Try a known-good screen; inspect the touch connector.
Diode-check FPC; trace OL lines through filters.
Split; check ripped pads; iSocket test; reball bottom board.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
